flowchart TD
  SCHED["⏰ Weekly Monday 8AM"] --> FETCH["📡 Fetch 8 Indicators"]
  FETCH --> YC["📈 Yield Curve\n10Y-2Y Spread"]
  FETCH --> SAHM["👥 Sahm Rule\nUnemployment Trend"]
  FETCH --> GDP["🏭 Real GDP\nQuarterly Growth"]
  FETCH --> PAY["💼 Nonfarm Payrolls\nJobs Trend"]
  FETCH --> CPI_N["🛒 CPI Inflation\nMoM Annualized"]
  FETCH --> RET["🛍️ Retail Sales\nConsumer Spend"]
  FETCH --> FED["🏦 Fed Funds Rate\nPolicy Stance"]
  FETCH --> DUR["🔧 Durable Goods\nFactory Orders"]
  YC --> SCORE["🧮 Compute Danger Score\nWeighted Signal Avg"]
  SAHM --> SCORE
  GDP --> SCORE
  PAY --> SCORE
  CPI_N --> SCORE
  RET --> SCORE
  FED --> SCORE
  DUR --> SCORE
  SCORE --> REGIME{"Regime?"}
  REGIME -->|"0-20"| G["🟢 GREEN\nExpansion"]
  REGIME -->|"20-40"| Y["🟡 YELLOW\nCaution"]
  REGIME -->|"40-60"| O["🟠 ORANGE\nWarning"]
  REGIME -->|"60+"| R["🔴 RED\nDanger"]
  G --> SAVE["💾 Save macro_regime"]
  Y --> SAVE
  O --> SAVE
  R --> SAVE
  SAVE --> ALERT["🔔 Dashboard Banner"]

SCHED.label: Weekly Monday 8AM
SCHED.description: Runs once per week via Claude Code scheduled task. Economic indicators are slow-moving — weekly is sufficient.
SCHED.addReason: Weekly cadence matches data release frequency. No point running daily.

FETCH.label: Fetch 8 Indicators
FETCH.description: Parallel fetch of 8 Alpha Vantage economic endpoints. Each fetch is cached 24h to avoid rate limits.
FETCH.addReason: Alpha Vantage has all required macro data free tier.

YC.label: Yield Curve
YC.description: 10Y minus 2Y Treasury spread. Historically inverts 12-18 months before recession. Weight: HIGH.
YC.addReason: Most reliable single recession predictor. All 7 recessions since 1969 followed inversion.

SAHM.label: Sahm Rule
SAHM.description: 3-month avg unemployment minus 12-month low. > 0.5% = recession in progress. Weight: HIGH.
SAHM.addReason: Claudia Sahm's rule: real-time recession detection, no revisions needed.

GDP.label: Real GDP Growth
GDP.description: Quarterly real GDP QoQ change. Two negative quarters = technical recession. Weight: MEDIUM.
GDP.addReason: Lagging but definitive. Confirms what leading indicators signal.

PAY.label: Nonfarm Payrolls
PAY.description: Monthly jobs added. < 100K for 3 consecutive months signals labor market weakness. Weight: MEDIUM.
PAY.addReason: Consumer spending depends on employment. Jobs = leading indicator of recession.

CPI_N.label: CPI Inflation
CPI_N.description: Monthly CPI annualized. High inflation + weak growth = stagflation. Stagflation is worst-case. Weight: LOW.
CPI_N.addReason: Stagflation (1970s) is worse than normal recession — Fed can't cut without making inflation worse.

RET.label: Retail Sales
RET.description: Monthly retail sales MoM. Consumer is 70% of GDP. Consecutive declines = contraction. Weight: MEDIUM.
RET.addReason: Direct read on consumer health. Slows before recession, recovers after.

FED.label: Fed Funds Rate
FED.description: Current federal funds rate. High rate > 5% + rising = restrictive monetary policy. Weight: MEDIUM.
FED.addReason: Tight policy is the primary cause of most recessions. Rate above 5% = significant drag.

DUR.label: Durable Goods
DUR.description: Monthly durable goods orders MoM. Factory orders signal business investment confidence. Weight: LOW.
DUR.addReason: Leading indicator for manufacturing sector and business capex.

SCORE.label: Compute Danger Score
SCORE.description: Weighted average of signal severity across all indicators. 0 = all green, 100 = all red. Each indicator weighted by predictive reliability.
SCORE.addReason: Single number prevents alarm fatigue. One bad indicator doesn't panic. Multiple = real signal.

REGIME.label: Regime Classification
REGIME.description: 0-20 → GREEN, 20-40 → YELLOW, 40-60 → ORANGE, 60+ → RED. Two HIGH signals together escalate from YELLOW to ORANGE.
REGIME.addReason: Regime gate prevents false alarms. Single bad data point doesn't trigger alert.

G.label: GREEN — Expansion
G.description: Economy healthy. No recession signals. Agents run normally.

Y.label: YELLOW — Caution
Y.description: 1-2 weak signals. Monitor closely. Dashboard shows caution banner. No automatic agent changes.
Y.addReason: Early warning. Not actionable alone but worth watching.

O.label: ORANGE — Warning
O.description: 3+ signals or both HIGH signals triggered. Consider reducing exposure. Dashboard shows warning banner.
O.addReason: Historical correlation: 3+ signals have preceded 80% of recessions.

R.label: RED — Danger
R.description: Danger score > 60. Recession likely or in progress. Consider defensive positioning. Dashboard shows red alert.
R.addReason: All major indicators aligned. Historical examples: 2007 Q4, 2019 Q4, 2001 Q1.

SAVE.label: Save macro_regime
SAVE.description: Writes regime, danger_score, signals_triggered, summary, raw_indicators to macro_regime table. One row per week.
SAVE.addReason: Persists history for trend analysis and future learning.

ALERT.label: Dashboard Banner
ALERT.description: If regime != GREEN, shows colored banner on DashboardHome and MacroSentinel card in MarketsPage.
ALERT.addReason: Advisory-only — not auto-throttling agents. User decides whether to act.

history.label: Yield Curve
history.reason: Highest-weight indicator — most reliable recession predictor

history.label: Sahm Rule
history.reason: Real-time recession detection without data revisions
